title: Wall Mount Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass | Allied Brass
short_title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod 2-1/2-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add space-saving hanging room with a wall mount retractable hooks and garment rod that pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in when not needed.

Highlights:
- Retractable rod extends for 2-1/2" of hanging space, then retracts to stay out of the way
- Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
- Holds up to 15 lb for coats, robes, or towels
- Customizable look: remove the included knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Wall-mounted design helps keep modern bathroom hardware organized without using floor space

Specs & installation:
- Category: Retractable hooks and garment rods
- Mounting: Wall mount; fits standard interior walls
- Hardware: 6/32 toggles; mounting hardware included
- Drilling required: one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around
- Overall size: 3.75" W x 2" H x 2" L; projection 1"
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Finish options: available in multiple designer finish options including statement colors

_previous.title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
